verdict.rationale: Rootly's workflow automation supports Jira actions and can 'file tickets' as part of incident response automation, and AI summaries reference 'action items' captured during incidents, implying some link to follow-up tracking and ticket sync. However, there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated action-item/follow-up tracking system with completion status or two-way sync guarantees to an issue tracker. Missing for 10: a dedicated action-items/follow-up-tracking feature description, explicit two-way sync/status update with Jira or other trackers, and any evidence (docs or community) that follow-ups are tracked to completion rather than just ticket creation.
